epistemic_scope: Model / Exact 12x12 Open-Quantum-System Strang-Split Lindblad + Colored 1/f^alpha Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Trajectory Simulation (N_traj >= 512 on CUDA) anchored to Exp131 (3 kOhm NbTiN L_res=300 um, B_M4=0.1785 T, Delta_z_cap*=8.0 nm, Best-of-6 31P flip-flop pairs, Exp109 Q_r anchor). No laboratory measurement.
anchor_references: Cywinski et al., Phys. Rev. B 77, 174509 (2008)
Motzoi et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 110501 (2009)
Didier et al., Phys. Rev. A 97, 022330 (2018)

EC1_ou_1f_noise_psd_and_cptp_precision.statement: Multi-OU 1/f^alpha noise generator (alpha in {0.8, 1.0, 1.2}, [1 Hz, 100 MHz]) matches target S(f)=S_0^2/f^alpha within <10% across [10 Hz, 10 MHz] and RMS within <5% of analytical integral; CUDA 12x12 Strang-split Lindblad maintains max|Tr(rho)-1| < 1e-9, max||rho-rho^dag|| < 1e-9, min_eigval >= -1e-9; noiseless XY4-DRAG-CZ achieves F_avg >= 0.999 and cavity leakage < 1e-4.

EC2_bare_cz_anchor_and_echo_breakthrough.statement: On heterogeneous 3 kOhm NbTiN Exp131 Best-of-6 donor pairs (Delta_z_cap=8 nm, Q_r=2e5, S_eps=1.0 ueV/rtHz, alpha=1.0, N_traj>=512): (a) Markovian bare CZ reproduces Exp131 CM4 collapse (F_avg in [0.72, 0.84]); (b) under real colored 1/f noise, (P2) FF-Echo-CZ strictly beats (P1) Bare Dispersive CZ, and (P3) XY4-Embedded DRAG-CZ achieves mean F_avg >= 0.95 and F_Bell >= 0.96.

EC3_xy4_drag_beats_ff_echo_under_pulse_a.statement: With finite 15 ns pi-pulses and 1.5% Rabi rotation error (eps_rot=0.015), (P3) XY4-Embedded DRAG-CZ strictly outperforms (P2) FF-Echo-CZ at S_eps=1.0 ueV/rtHz and reduces cavity leakage vs unshaped no-DRAG XY4; across noise color alpha in {0.8, 1.0, 1.2}, echoed CZ fidelity increases strictly monotonically with alpha (F(0.8) < F(1.0) < F(1.2)).

EC4_sweetspot_p4_surface_code_threshold_.statement: (P4) Sweet-Spot Parametric AC-Stark / Modulated g(t) Echo CZ (clock-transition partial omega_q/partial eps ~ 0 + Bessel-flattened parametric coupling + XY4-DRAG echo) achieves F_avg >= 0.985 and F_Bell >= 0.990 at nominal M4 (3 kOhm, Q_r=2e5, S_eps=1.0 ueV/rtHz, alpha=1.0), and strictly outperforms (P1)-(P3) at S_eps=2.0 ueV/rtHz.

EC5_2d_fault_tolerance_envelope_and_fail.statement: Across the 5x4 (S_eps in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0} ueV/rtHz x Q_r in {5e4, 1e5, 2e5, 5e5}) phase map, best echoed protocol (P4) clears F_Bell >= 0.990 across Q_r >= 2e5, S_eps <= 1.0 ueV/rtHz and reaches F_Bell >= 0.994 at (Q_r=5e5, S_eps=0.5), while extreme noise + low-Q (S_eps=5.0, Q_r=5e4) drops below F_avg < 0.96 (transparent failure wall).

EC6_transverse_dg_jitter_honest_budget.statement: Explicitly activating full transverse coupling-strength 1/f jitter dg(t)=(dg/deps)*de(t) (which X-echo cannot cancel) degrades unmitigated (P2)/(P3) at S_eps=1.0 ueV/rtHz by Delta_F_dg > 0.005, while (P4) Bessel-stationary parametric modulation / flat-g operation suppresses the dg penalty by >= 3x.

EC7_exact_pauli_error_channel_for_exp138.statement: Full 16-element Choi/PTM Pauli error channel projection at S_eps=1.0 and 0.5 ueV/rtHz satisfies exact probability sum |sum(p_a)-1| < 1e-6, Nielsen identity |F_avg - (4*p_I+1)/5| < 1e-5, and residual cavity leakage p_leak < 0.005 for Exp138 surface-code decoding.

success_rule: All 7 pre-registered predictions EC1 through EC7 PASS (any FAIL documented transparently with physical root cause).
